scripts.dev: npm run docs:generate -- --skip-previews && npm run build:modules && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace @rzmps/rzmps" "npm run dev --workspace @rzmps/ammo" "npm run dev --workspace @rzmps/jolt" "npm run dev --workspace @rzmps/rapier" "node scripts/site/dev.mjs"
scripts.build:modules: npm run build --workspace @rzmps/rzmps && npm run build --workspace @rzmps/ammo && npm run build --workspace @rzmps/jolt && npm run build --workspace @rzmps/rapier
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate -- --skip-previews && npm run build:modules && node scripts/site/dev.mjs
scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:build && node --test scripts/docs/examples.test.mjs scripts/docs/distribution.test.mjs scripts/docs/navigation.test.mjs && node scripts/docs/check-links.mjs
scripts.site:build: npm run build:modules && npm run docs:check && npm run build --workspace demo && node scripts/site/assemble.mjs
